scripts.build:check: skill_build_tmp=$(mktemp) && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=$skill_build_tmp >/dev/null && cmp -s $skill_build_tmp agents/issue-triage/scripts/issue-triage.mjs; skill_build_status=$?; rm -f $skill_build_tmp; exit $skill_build_status
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:check
